families.rationale: All three views retain a compact simple hexagonal prism across the registered rho variation.
All three variants remain broad six-sided planar plates with modest edge thickness.
Oblique and axial views retain the long hollow axial column and every variant is fully framed.
Each planar crystal keeps six broad stellar arms while varying branch reach modestly.
Every variant shows a central axial column bounded by distinct plate caps with ample vertical clearance.
The face views retain six broad divided sectors in all three registered variants.
All three variants remain slender axial needles and are fully contained in the tall domain.
Each face view retains dense fernlike secondary branching along all six primary arms.
Each result remains a solid elongated hexagonal column and is fully framed vertically.
The trio retains thin elongated sheath-like axial forms with sufficient vertical clearance.
All three face views retain visibly divided or split planar stellar structure.
Each tall result retains an isolated tapered bullet-like axial body and remains fully framed.
The raised asymmetric scroll feature remains connected to the plate in every selected stop.
All three selected early stops retain the triangular outer form while showing positive growth.
Oblique and axial views retain an open cup wall and base across all three selected stops.
Every variant preserves a visible central plate cavity at its registered cavity radius.
Oblique and axial views retain a raised central axial structure over the plate, with all three variants fully framed.
All three results retain open blocky skeletal arms rather than a filled planar plate.
Each face view retains a six-primary-arm star outline across the small rho variation.
All three crystals retain long sixfold arms with visible secondary side branching.
Axial and oblique views retain two separated plate levels in all three variants.
The adjacent 4500, 5000 and 5500 stops each retain a long tapered bullet body and distinct hexagonal plate cap, with a visibly broadening cap sequence.
